entities.name: Denis Kiwanuka Lote

entities.summary: Denis Kiwanuka Lote was a Ugandan Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Tororo from 27 June 2007 until 2 January 2014. He previously served as Bishop of Kotido from 20 May 1991 until 27 June 2007.
